summary: Ran the S10T07 release gate across runtime, CLI, storage, skills/workflows, console, browser, daemon, MCP, and package smoke surfaces. Found and fixed stale pnpm workspace metadata that left apps/daemon and apps/mcp without lockfile importers and made daemon package scripts fail to resolve workspace packages. Added a package-smoke regression check for workspace lockfile importers/dependencies and made the console package smoke use the fixture bwrk shim instead of ambient PATH. Final verification passed.
command: CI=true pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile; pnpm bwrk sync refresh --json; pnpm bwrk doctor --strict --json; pnpm check; pnpm test; pnpm console:build; pnpm console:smoke; pnpm console:browser-smoke; pnpm bwrk doctor skills --json; pnpm bwrk dashboard global --json; pnpm daemon:status; pnpm daemon:watch:once; pnpm mcp:dev; git diff --check
